recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-17399 follow-up is needed in core source unless a future substantive edit to the Person linking paragraph provides an opportunity for incidental grammar cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-17399 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration clarification asking the Person linking narrative to stop saying that the Person link element could not link to RelatedPerson entries, because Person.link can reference RelatedPerson.
initial_application: Commit baca2ec26671f781bf91a59f6a6279e3a9bfcbe7 explicitly applied FHIR-17399 by replacing the contradictory Person notes paragraph; merge 6a22234ecafea0d1b5c5656c4c6a61989f9cceac brought it into the R5 backlog work, and a later STU-note macro cleanup preserved the corrected meaning.
additional_context: Person is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Person notes explain that prior Patient.link limitations left Person to link RelatedPerson records, that Patient.link has supported RelatedPerson since STU3, and that using Person for this linkage remains possible. Current Person.link.target and Patient.link.other both include RelatedPerson. The originating Zulip thread and PA minutes corroborate the Jira request and final disposition.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already resolves the semantic contradiction raised by the issue. A minor grammar-only polish opportunity in the note does not change implementer understanding and is below the source-edit threshold for this reconciliation.
